title: Kissed Japanese Oregano Soba
description: A rich, crumbly soba dish infused with aromatic oregano, savory miso sauce, and a crispy topping that pleases crowds and stays tamasic-friendly.
instructions: Cook soba noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water.
In a small bowl whisk soy sauce, miso paste, mirin, sugar, sesame oil, water, garlic, ginger, and scallions until smooth.
Heat the sauce mixture in a skillet over medium heat until it thickens slightly, about 2 minutes.
Toss the cooked noodles with the warm sauce, ensuring each strand is coated.
In a separate pan, lightly toast the crushed almonds and tofu crumble until fragrant.
Arrange the sauced noodles on a serving platter, sprinkle with the toasted almond and tofu topping.
Add a final drizzle of sesame oil and a sprinkle of dried oregano for aroma.
Serve immediately, garnished with extra scallion slices if desired.
